# airy1-gumbel-lean

> Lean 4 companion to Le Chen and Fei Pu, "Gumbel Fluctuations of the Maximum of the Airy_1 Process" (arXiv 2611.23658). It proves that the maximum over [0, T] of a constructed Airy_1 process, centred and scaled as in the paper, converges to the Gumbel law, assuming three named inputs; since v0.10.0 the first two are proved with no hypothesis, so it also holds under the third, `CubicStrongMixing`, alone. It does not certify the whole manuscript.

Claim boundary (read first):
- Headline: `Airy1Gumbel.gumbel_limit_continuum_real_normalized_airy1_final₂` in Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean.
- Its hypotheses: `Airy1FddPositive` (finite-dimensional Airy_1 laws), `GOELeftTail` (cubic one-point left tail), `CubicStrongMixing` (cubic strong mixing). They are hypotheses of the headline, which is unchanged; `CubicStrongMixing` is an assumption, not a theorem.
- Since v0.10.0, `GOELeftTail` and `Airy1FddPositive` are proved with no hypothesis: `Airy1Gumbel.goeLeftTail_holds` in Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTailDischarge.lean (Hermite localization, with contrib/Airy1GumbelContrib/GOE/) and `Airy1Gumbel.airy1FddPositive_holds` in Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTailCorollaries.lean. `Airy1Gumbel.gumbel_limit_continuum_real_normalized_airy1_final₂_no_fdd_goe_input` in the same file has the headline's conclusion under `CubicStrongMixing` only. The original statements, among them `_final₂` and `_final₂_no_fdd_input`, are unchanged and still take the records as hypotheses; no input is added. The same file has 15 input-free corollaries of paper statements (`_no_fdd_goe_input`), each keeping its original's other inputs. The comparator checks `goeLeftTail_holds`, `airy1FddPositive_holds` and `_final₂_no_fdd_goe_input` too.
- Since v0.9.0, `Airy1FddPositive` is proved under `GOELeftTail`, not unconditionally: `Airy1Gumbel.airy1FddPositive_of_goeLeftTail` in Airy1Gumbel/FddFromTasep.lean (flat discrete TASEP and its scaling limit, in contrib/Airy1GumbelContrib/FddMeasure/). `Airy1Gumbel.gumbel_limit_continuum_real_normalized_airy1_final₂_no_fdd_input` in Airy1Gumbel/FddFromTasepCorollaries.lean has the headline's conclusion under `GOELeftTail` and `CubicStrongMixing` only; those two are assumptions. `_final₂` is unchanged and still takes `Airy1FddPositive`; the comparator checks `_final₂`, `_final₂_coord` and, since v0.9.0, `airy1FddPositive_of_goeLeftTail` and `_final₂_no_fdd_input`.
- The headline's mesoscopic step uses a two-time Fredholm determinant bound, not the paper's association and covariance argument; the headline uses only the specialisation of Proposition 4.3 needed in Section 5.2, proved along the two-point route.
- Proposition 1.2 (two-term tail expansion over a fixed interval) is proved for the constructed process for every T > 0, under `Airy1FddPositive` and `GOELeftTail`: `Airy1Gumbel.airy1Law_interval_tail_sub_traceLead_isLittleO` in Airy1Gumbel/BlockLawUnconditional.lean (since v0.2.0).
- Lemma 3.1 (two-interval determinant formula) is proved for the constructed process for every equal length T > 0, in the trace-class form (3.3) of Remark 3.2, under `Airy1FddPositive` and `GOELeftTail`: `Airy1Gumbel.airy1Law_two_blocks_le_eq_fredholmDet_of_length` in Airy1Gumbel/TwoIntervalLaw.lean (since v0.3.0). The determinant displayed in (3.1) has no separate Lean definition.
- Lemma 4.1 (block modulus, eq. (4.1)) is proved for the constructed process under `Airy1FddPositive`, `GOELeftTail` and a fourth named input, `NonnegativeWindowModulusEstimate`: the transferred local oscillation bound (4.2) of arXiv:2611.23658v1 on windows inside [0, infinity), which the paper derives from Basu-Bhattacharjee (2024) and which is assumed, not proved, here: `Airy1Gumbel.block_modulus_airy1` in Airy1Gumbel/BlockModulus.lean (since v0.4.0). The headline does not use this input.
- Lemma 4.2 (threshold-sensitive Newman bound, eq. (4.3)) is proved for the constructed continuous process, for every u >= u0 and every lag d >= 0 with constants independent of d, under the standing inputs `Airy1FddPositive` and `GOELeftTail` and the association input `ProcessAssociated`: the association of the Airy_1 process (Pu 2025, Theorem 1.2), an existing named input that is assumed, not proved, here: `Airy1Gumbel.tail_sensitive_newman_airy1` in Airy1Gumbel/TailSensitiveNewman.lean (since v0.5.0). The covariance is genuine (both marginals proved square-integrable, `Airy1Gumbel.memLp_two_airy1ContR`); the one-point tail ratio is proved from the GOE Fredholm determinant, so no new named input. The headline does not use `ProcessAssociated`.
- Proposition 4.3 (mesoscopic sum, eq. (4.6)) is proved as a standalone result for the constructed continuous process, for every chi in ((1/2)^(1/3), 1) and every cutoff R(M) = O(sqrt(M)), along the paper's route: `Airy1Gumbel.mesoscopic_sum_airy1` in Airy1Gumbel/MesoscopicStandalone.lean (since v0.6.0). Its hypotheses are the standing inputs `Airy1FddPositive` and `GOELeftTail` and three named inputs, each assumed, not proved, here: `NonnegativeWindowModulusEstimate` (the bound (4.2), Basu-Bhattacharjee 2024; the input of Lemma 4.1), `ProcessAssociated` (association, Pu 2025, Theorem 1.2; the input of Lemma 4.2) and `CubicCovarianceDecay` (the covariance asymptotic of the Airy_1 process, Basu-Busani-Ferrari 2023, Theorem 1.1). No new named input. The headline uses none of these three.
- Remark 5.3 (the Gumbel limit derived from the Ferrari-Liu persistence estimates) is proved for the constructed continuous process along integer lengths, as the remark states: `Airy1Gumbel.gumbel_limit_continuum_airy1_ferrariLiu` in Airy1Gumbel/FerrariLiuRoute.lean (since v0.8.0). Its hypotheses are the standing inputs `Airy1FddPositive` and `GOELeftTail` and a new named input, `FerrariLiuPersistence`: the finite-length persistence expansion of Ferrari-Liu (2024), assumed, not proved, here, and used only by Remark 5.3. The headline does not use it.
- `Airy1Gumbel.airy1FddPositive_of_rectangle` in Airy1Gumbel/FddRectangle.lean (since v0.8.0) derives `Airy1FddPositive` from `GOELeftTail` and three properties of `AiryFdd.airy1FinCdf` (nonnegativity, monotonicity, nonnegative rectangle increments), using the finite-box measure constructor `AiryFdd.exists_measure_of_box_cdf` in contrib/Airy1GumbelContrib/FddMeasure/BoxCdf.lean; since v0.9.0 the three properties are proved (FddFromTasep.lean).
- Lemmas 3.3-3.8 are proved in the contrib package (3.6 and 3.7 as stated; 3.3, 3.4, 3.5 in a different form; 3.8 in a weaker form, Hilbert-Schmidt rather than trace norms) Lemmas B.1-B.6 are proved in the contrib library as stated (B.4 and B.6 on a larger parameter range), with no named input. All twelve are shown as outside in coverage.yaml only because its rows can name main-package claims alone; each row gives the declarations.
- Axioms: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` only; no `sorry`.

## Required context
- [README](README.md): result, inputs, what is not proved, build commands.
- [coverage.yaml](coverage.yaml): the paper-to-Lean map against arXiv 2611.23658v1.
- [claims.yaml](claims.yaml) and [contrib/claims.yaml](contrib/claims.yaml): the named Lean results.
- [Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean](Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean): the headline.
- [Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean](Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean), [Airy1Gumbel/FddRecord.lean](Airy1Gumbel/FddRecord.lean), [Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTail.lean](Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTail.lean): the named inputs of the headline.
- [Airy1Gumbel/BlockModulus.lean](Airy1Gumbel/BlockModulus.lean): Lemma 4.1 and its fourth named input `NonnegativeWindowModulusEstimate` (assumed).
- [Airy1Gumbel/TailSensitiveNewman.lean](Airy1Gumbel/TailSensitiveNewman.lean): Lemma 4.2 under `ProcessAssociated` (assumed; stated in Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean).
- [Airy1Gumbel/MesoscopicStandalone.lean](Airy1Gumbel/MesoscopicStandalone.lean): Proposition 4.3 under `NonnegativeWindowModulusEstimate`, `ProcessAssociated` and `CubicCovarianceDecay` (all three assumed; the last two stated in Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean).
- [Airy1Gumbel/FerrariLiuRoute.lean](Airy1Gumbel/FerrariLiuRoute.lean): Remark 5.3 and its named input `FerrariLiuPersistence` (assumed).

## Gates
- Build: `lake exe cache get && lake build Airy1Gumbel Airy1GumbelContrib`.
- Audit: `lake env lean AxiomCheck.lean > t.txt && python3 scripts/audit.py t.txt` (exact theorem inventory, approved axioms, no proof escapes); the same for contrib/.
- Comparator: Challenge.lean (Mathlib-only statements of Theorem 1.1, with the objects defined in ChallengeDefs/Airy1Gumbel/), Solution.lean (proofs from the package), comparator.json.
- Receipts: verify.sh and contrib/verify.sh, run through lean-pkg.

## Optional
- [contrib/](contrib/): Gumbel law, Airy functions, Mills ratio, Hilbert-Schmidt and trace-class operators, Fredholm determinants, Airy_1 finite-dimensional and two-time estimates.
